import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        run_len = j - i
        if run_len % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
